chunks: From him, from Fadalah, from Ibn Sinan, from more than one, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"If forgetfulness becomes frequent upon you, then continue in your prayer."
ai.seo_question: What should a Muslim do if they experience frequent forgetfulness during prayer?
ai.summary: In the context of Shia fiqh, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) establishes the principle of 'continuity' (istimrar) for those suffering from chronic forgetfulness (mukathir al-sehv), distinguishing their ruling from those with occasional lapses. It emphasizes that the validity of the prayer is not compromised by repeated minor errors, provided the worshipper does not intentionally abandon the prayer, thereby alleviating the anxiety of the devout. This ruling is foundational in the chapter on the laws of forgetfulness within Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, reflecting the practical jurisprudence of the Imams.
